item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: Make this wide sneaker pic square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it'll cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest—and safest—option is **square padding, not AI editing**.

- Put the entire photo on a **512 × 512 px canvas**, adding space above and below.
- Keep the whole sneaker and original photo unchanged: **no cropping, stretching, or regeneration**.
- **Cost: 0 Magic Hour credits** using a standard editor such as Canva or your phone’s canvas/border tool.

A free-plan Magic Hour AI edit starts at **5 credits for one image at 640px**, but it could alter details, so I wouldn’t recommend it for your “don’t change anything else” requirement. A smaller AI output won’t beat free padding; “shorter” doesn’t apply to a still image.

**Nothing has been run or charged.** Would you like quick steps for adding white padding for free?

turns.agent:
Here’s how to add **white padding for free in Canva**:

1. Create a custom design sized **512 × 512 px**.
2. Set the canvas background to **white**.
3. Upload `product-sneaker.jpg` and add it as an image—not as the background.
4. Resize it proportionally to **512 px wide**, keeping the entire photo visible.
5. Center it horizontally and vertically. This leaves about **102 px of white space above and below**.
6. Download as **PNG** using the free download option.

This preserves the whole photo without cropping or stretching. **No Magic Hour credits spent.**
